name: delight
description: Pleasant but fleeting experience of something exceeding expectations, often unexpected.

commentaries.quote: Simple delight is the basic primal positive experience, though it can happen at all levels. There are many complex experiences that create deep-down delight. For example, at a social level, finding wild raspberries may create excitement about sharing the news with others.

experiences: many positive experiences create basic delight

conditions: Something happened perceived to be on the upper end of expected possible outcomes.
